product_description: Practice management software for independent veterinary clinics that handles appointment scheduling, medical records (SOAP notes), inventory management, invoicing, and client communication in one platform.
business_objective: Replace legacy veterinary software and spreadsheets for independent vet practices with 1-10 vets
icp: Independent veterinary practices in the US, 1-10 vets, not part of a corporate chain
user_persona: Veterinarians, vet techs, and front desk staff
existing_workflow: Receptionists schedule in Google Calendar or paper, vets write SOAP notes on paper or in Word docs, invoices created in QuickBooks, client reminders sent manually via phone
